Fly into Bagdogra Airport (IXB), then take a shared jeep or taxi to Gangtok (4 hrs). Pakyong Airport near Gangtok also has limited connectivity. Inner Line Permits required for North Sikkim.
Fly into Bhuj Airport from Mumbai or Ahmedabad. Trains from Ahmedabad to Bhuj run regularly (overnight journey). The Rann Utsav season (Nov-Feb) has special camp packages.
Fly into Dimapur Airport from Kolkata, Delhi, or Guwahati. Then drive to Kohima (3 hrs). Inner Line Permit (ILP) required for all non-residents — get it in Delhi, Kolkata, or at Dimapur.
Fly into Leh Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport (direct from Delhi, Mumbai, Srinagar). Road trips via Manali-Leh Highway or Srinagar-Leh Highway are legendary but require acclimatisation stops.
